description: Find Environment Agency water-quality sampling points near a WGS84 point (England; OGL v3). Returns bounded metadata, not a water-safety assessment. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

lat.description: Confirmed WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees; pair with lon.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

lon.description: Confirmed WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees; pair with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres; spatial tools use a bounding box around the point.

name: wq_sampling_points
